speaker: rep
text: Hi Priya, thanks for making time today. How's the week going?

speaker: prospect
text: Pretty hectic, but good. We just wrapped our quarterly kickoff.

speaker: rep
text: Nice. To start, can you tell me how your team reviews sales calls today?

speaker: prospect
text: Our managers listen to a handful of recordings each week, mostly in the car.

speaker: prospect
text: A few of the reps also used Gong at their previous company.

speaker: rep
text: Got it. And what happens after a call ends?

speaker: prospect
text: Honestly the reps type notes into the CRM and that has been working fine for us.

speaker: rep
text: That makes sense. Let me show you what the live cue cards look like.

speaker: prospect
text: Before you do, how much does this cost per rep?

speaker: rep
text: It depends on the modules, but I can share the price sheet after the demo.

speaker: prospect
text: Okay, because our tools budget was cut this year and anything expensive is a hard sell.

speaker: rep
text: Understood. Most teams start with a small pilot.

speaker: prospect
text: We also have a call with Clari on Thursday.

speaker: prospect
text: And I would need our VP of sales to sign off before we commit to anything.

speaker: rep
text: Would it help if I joined a short call with your VP next week?

speaker: prospect
text: Yes, send me a calendar invite for Tuesday afternoon.

speaker: prospect
text: Just so you know, we probably can't roll anything out until next quarter.

speaker: rep
text: No problem. I will send the invite and a one page summary today.
